name: Lokalise - Upload Figma screenshots
description: Webhook: POST {items:[{project_id,url,title,description,key_ids,tags}]} -> fetches each Figma render URL, base64-encodes it and uploads it to Lokalise as a screenshot linked to the given keys.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ screenshots: [ { data: $json.dataUri, title: $json.title, description: $json.description, ocr: $json.ocr, key_ids: $json.key_ids, tags: $json.tags } ] }) }}
